invariants.rationale: The method accesses element.getString("type", ""); thus, element must not be null.
parentLayers is passed unchanged to all called sub-methods and should be non-null for expected execution.
tmjFile is required in every called branch except tilelayer; its presence suggests it should not be null when invoked.
imageResolver is only used in group and imagelayer branches, so if the type is not one of those, imageResolver may be null.
map is a core object in the method signature and is always used as an argument, suggesting it must not be null.
